objective: Test whether historical rookie-draft evidence supports a monotone exact overall-pick Fundamental Value curve for overall picks 1-48 without using market data to fit or select the historical estimator.

scope.historical_source_round_size_role: Frozen development-source fact used to recover overall pick; not a runtime assumption for future leagues.

axis_and_estimand.round_dot_slot_rule: Round.slot labels are presentation metadata only. Historical estimation must use trustworthy overall pick. A future runtime may map a known round.slot to overall pick only from the league's actual draft size/order; it must never assume 12 teams when league size is unknown.
axis_and_estimand.estimand: E[H3.O2 outcome | overall rookie pick], using the frozen V8/V10 occurrence and class weighting estimand
axis_and_estimand.point_estimation: Preserve V10's exact weighting estimand at the cell level. Within each training-set draft class and V10 cell, normalize frozen development_fit_weight_v8 over retained occurrences exactly as V10. Give each training-set draft class equal total cell weight (1/Nclasses). Exact-slot values are the conditional weighted means induced by those class/cell weights; this preserves equal class macro weight without pretending repeated league selections are independent.
axis_and_estimand.repeated_rookie_rule: Repeated league selections remain occurrence-weighted in the point estimand but must be clustered by stable rookie identity for uncertainty; repeated selections are not independent outcomes.

historical_source_mapping.source_contract: The frozen V7/V8 development source is a 12-pick-per-round rookie-draft source. For retained development rows, overall_slot must equal (round-1)*12 + within_round_pick, with within_round_pick 1..12.
historical_source_mapping.phase0a_required_assertion: Every retained R1-R4 occurrence must satisfy the frozen 12-pick source mapping and its stored V10 cell must equal the cell implied by overall_slot. If the historical V10 cell assignment is not exactly a union of the listed overall-pick slots, STOP before outcomes.
historical_source_mapping.runtime_separation: This historical source mapping does not authorize a 12-team assumption for future user leagues. Runtime exact-slot lookup must use a known overall pick or the league's actual draft size/order.

axis_and_estimand.within_cell_weight_definition: For training-class set T and cell c, normalize development_fit_weight_v8 within each year y and cell c so each year/cell sums to 1. Give each y in T weight 1/|T|. For slot s in c, define A(c,s,T) as the sum of those weighted occurrence masses at s. A(c,s,T) sums to 1 across the four slots in c. The raw slot outcome mean uses the same weighted occurrence masses conditional on s. Therefore sum_s A(c,s,T)*raw_slot_EV(s,T) must reproduce the refit V10 cell EV for T before projection.

primary_architecture.raw_curve: Compute a raw class-balanced expected H3.O2 outcome for each overall pick 1-48 using only historical outcomes after Phase 0 source gates are frozen and passed.

projection.algorithm_family: deterministic convex quadratic program equivalent to weighted isotonic projection with equality constraints
projection.weights: For each training set T, use the frozen V10-induced slot masses A(c,s,T) defined in axis_and_estimand; no weights may be tuned from outcomes or market residuals.
projection.bucket_mean_constraints: Within each of the twelve explicitly listed V10 R1-R4 cells, preserve the corresponding PRE-BRIDGE V10 fundamental-core bucket mean. Full-data final projection uses the six-class refit anchor; each LOYO projection must recompute both A(c,s,T) and the bucket anchor using only its five training classes.

primary_architecture.market_translation: Only after the historical fundamental curve is frozen, apply the already-frozen V10 global market bridge as a translation for later construct validation. Do not use the bridge to select the historical curve.
primary_architecture.option_3_status: NOT_A_SEPARATE_ESTIMATOR; bucket-mean preservation is absorbed as a deterministic constraint inside Option 1H.

fallback_policy.reason: Avoid hidden model-family and regularization degrees of freedom with only six development classes.
fallback_policy.tier_a: Attempt the 48-slot Option 1H curve only if frozen direct source-support gates pass.
fallback_policy.tier_b: If exact-slot source support is insufficient but preregistered pooled support remains adequate, a later separately frozen lower-resolution adjacent-slot-block study may be proposed. It is not automatically selected or fit by V1.

direct_per_slot.distinct_rookies_slots_1_4_note: This 10-rookie floor is effectively implied by >=2 distinct rookies in at least 5 classes and is retained explicitly for audit clarity.

concentration.provider_or_format_exception: Only an already-frozen source-weighting contract may justify exceeding 0.60; no new exception may be created after diagnostics.

whole_curve.precision_simulation_policy: The Phase 0A precision-simulation code and pass criterion must exist in a separate reviewed commit before any occurrence corpus is materialized or read. Record that code hash in the Phase 0A manifest. The simulation may tighten/STOP but may not loosen any B52 support threshold.

pooled_window_diagnostic_only.role: Diagnostic for whether a separately preregistered lower-resolution follow-up could be scientifically plausible; it does not auto-authorize Option 2.

phase0a_mandatory_diagnostics: exact overall-pick recoverability and conflicts by class, round, provider and source
draft type and league size where source metadata allow it; explicitly report unknown rate
format mix by overall pick where source metadata allow it, including 1QB vs superflex and TEP if present
occurrence count by slot and slot-class
distinct rookie count by slot and slot-class
class-balanced Kish effective sample size by slot and slot-class
all six class representation by slot
single-league, top-five-league, provider and format concentration
repeated-rookie multiplicity and adjacent-slot rookie overlap
source fields physically projected to a declared outcome-blind allowlist
assertion that no H3, O2, fantasy points, market, KTC, package-vote or future-outcome field is read
outcome-blind precision simulation using only the frozen aggregate V10 bucket uncertainty plus source structure under a preregistered algorithm
physical development-class filter: materialized Phase 0A and Phase 1 estimator inputs must contain exactly draft classes 2018-2023; assert no 2024+ outcome row is read or materialized

go_to_phase1_requires: at least 43 of 48 slots pass the direct support tier
all 48 slots contain all six development classes with at least one distinct rookie

phase1_estimation_and_validation.primary_uncertainty: For each pre-projection slot curve, treat the six class-level estimates as the primary sampling units and report mean +/- t(df=5)*SD/sqrt(6): t90=2.015 and t95=2.571.
phase1_estimation_and_validation.post_projection_uncertainty: Bayesian bootstrap with Dirichlet class weights plus rookie-level weights within class; rerun the entire frozen projection in every replicate. Also report leave-one-class-out ranges.
phase1_estimation_and_validation.nested_incumbent_comparator: In every leave-one-draft-class-out fold, refit the V10 early/mid/late historical bucket estimator using only the five training classes. The exact-slot raw curve, V10-induced slot masses A(c,s,T), and all bucket-mean equality anchors are also recomputed using only those same five training classes. Full-data six-class anchors are forbidden inside LOYO.

s2_incremental_predictive_value.metric: For each held-out class, class-balanced weighted squared error on held-out occurrences; define paired improvement D_y = loss_refit_V10_y - loss_exact_slot_y so positive favors exact slots.
s2_incremental_predictive_value.paired_class_level_improvement_test: one-sided paired t test on the six D_y values

s3_spacing_stability.rule: For each V10 bucket, first-slot relative value (V_first/refit_training_bucket_mean) must be strictly greater than last-slot relative value (V_last/refit_training_bucket_mean) in at least 5 of 6 LOYO fits.
s3_spacing_stability.round_pass_rule: A round passes S3 only if all three of its early/mid/late buckets pass S3.

s4_projection_does_not_do_the_work.movement_fraction_definition: Within a round and fit, numerator=sum_s w_s*abs(projected_s-raw_s); denominator=sum_s w_s*abs(raw_s), using the fit-specific frozen V10-induced slot weights normalized within that round. Denominator must be >0.
s4_projection_does_not_do_the_work.slot_change_fraction_definition: For each slot and fit: abs(projected_s-raw_s)/abs(raw_s). A nonpositive or zero raw slot EV is an automatic failure.
s4_projection_does_not_do_the_work.scope: The 5% movement-fraction and 30% any-slot limits must pass in the full-data fit and every LOYO fit.
s4_projection_does_not_do_the_work.round_pass_rule: A round passes S4 only if both S4 limits pass for that round in the full-data fit and all six LOYO fits.

s5_bucket_mean_reconciliation.rule: Before projection, reconstruct every V10 cell from the raw exact-slot curve using A(c,s,T). For the six-class full-data fit it must reproduce the twelve six-class PRE-BRIDGE V10 fundamental-core EVs; in LOYO, it must reproduce the five-training-class refit V10 cell EVs.

phase1_estimation_and_validation.adjacent_slot_claim_rule: A monotone point estimate may exist without pairwise significance. Do not claim a specific adjacent slot is superior unless its interval supports that claim.

partial_adoption.round_failure: A round fails exact-slot adoption if any of its three buckets fails S3 or if the round fails S4.
partial_adoption.reversion: A failed round reverts to the V10 early/mid/late representation; no within-bucket exact spacing is used for that round.
partial_adoption.global_monotone_after_reversion: Combine passing exact-slot rounds and reverted V10-bucket rounds in fundamental units and enforce/check the frozen global non-increasing boundary constraints without changing either component. If the hybrid is infeasible, STOP the V1 exact-slot deployment.
partial_adoption.hybrid_incremental_gate: If any round reverts, rerun S2 on the frozen hybrid candidate in every LOYO fold. The same >=5/6 win rule and t>=1.476 requirement must still pass; otherwise STOP.

phase1_estimation_and_validation.development_input_firewall: Phase 0A and Phase 1 materialized estimator inputs are physically restricted to draft classes 2018-2023. Code must assert the observed class set is a subset of exactly {2018,2019,2020,2021,2022,2023}; any 2024+ outcome row read before the forward-holdout opening is a governance breach.

r4_r5_boundary.check_stage: After the R1-R4 historical curve is frozen and translated by the frozen V10 global market bridge, but before YEAR_DISCOUNT and before any production authorization.
r4_r5_boundary.rule: Bridge-translated value at overall pick 48 must be >= the frozen V10 R5-early PICK_BASE value. The workflow must assert YEAR_DISCOUNT['2027']==1.0, but the boundary itself is defined before year discount.

forward_holdout.additional_open_guard: Do not read any 2024 H3 outcome row until the 2026 regular season including Week 18 is complete, the full frozen H3 outcome source is available, and a pre-outcome 2024 source/weight contract compatible with overall picks 1-48 is frozen.
forward_holdout.physical_firewall: Phase 0A and Phase 1 inputs must be physically filtered to 2018-2023 and assert no 2024+ outcome row is materialized. Reading any 2024 outcome row before holdout maturity is a governance breach.

holdout_test.candidate: the exact/hybrid V1 curve frozen after all development gates and before 2024 H3 outcomes open
holdout_test.comparator: the V10 PRE-BRIDGE early/mid/late historical predictor frozen/refit on development classes 2018-2023 only; 2024 outcomes may not alter either candidate
holdout_test.metric: weighted mean squared H3.O2 prediction error on eligible 2024 R1-R4 occurrences under the frozen 2024 pre-outcome source/weight contract

forward_holdout.2025_class: reserve as later forward holdout when H3 matures

market_firewall.phase2_failure_rule: Report failure and retain current production, or preregister a new V2 study. Never refit V1 to reduce market residuals.

phase_sequence: Phase 0A outcome-blind source feasibility and precision audit
Phase 1 historical fundamental exact-slot curve under frozen architecture
Phase 3 shadow and separate production authorization

read exact-slot KTC or trade-market values before the Phase 1 historical curve is frozen
use 2027 production PICK_BASE values as projection anchors
use YEAR_DISCOUNT in historical exact-slot estimation
fit or retune the V10 global market bridge
change thresholds after Phase 0A source diagnostics
switch to a hierarchical/spline family after seeing exact-slot outcomes
treat repeated selections of the same rookie as independent outcomes for uncertainty
infer an exact slot for a future pick whose actual order is unknown
reopen R5-R6 tail estimation in V1
change player FV, Package Adjustment, Team Utility or trade verdict math
read or materialize any 2024+ H3/O2 outcome row in Phase 0A or Phase 1
